credit_policy.direct_provenance: Only source_anchor_ids stored on merge.html node/edge payload; current count is zero.
credit_policy.derived_provenance: A returned graph node/edge may be labeled derived only when its ID is present in the explicit sidecar with provenance_class=derived and source_anchor_ids.
credit_policy.cross_paper_graph_use: A returned derived/direct graph node counts as cross-paper only when it has at least two distinct source paper IDs. A direct graph edge would also qualify, but a derived edge does not: its paper_ids are inherited from endpoint closure and do not prove the relation itself.
credit_policy.edge_provenance: Derived edge provenance is endpoint closure; it is not a direct source relation anchor.

limitations: The sidecar reverse closure supports audit navigation but does not upgrade merge.html provenance to direct.
Unresolved edges can retain paper_ids inherited from resolved endpoints; they receive no cross-paper credit under the item-level policy.
Scientific decision quality is not inferred from retrieval or provenance metrics.
